comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Mexico is almost impossible to summarize through a single cultural or geographic identity. 🇲🇽🌵 Deserts in the north, tropical forests in the south, Indigenous communities, enormous cities and two very different coastlines have produced many distinct regional realities. That internal diversity is probably the biggest thing that disappears when Mexico is reduced to its most familiar tourist images.

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Absolutely! 🇲🇽 Mexico is so much more than the images most people are familiar with. Its incredible regional diversity, from its landscapes to its cultures and communities, is what makes the country so fascinating. We’re glad you highlighted this important point. Thank you for sharing such a thoughtful perspective! 🙌
